facts.claim: Québec tourism highlights decorated City Hall and Petit-Champlain, and Halloween on the Plains of Abraham from early October to mid-November.
facts.excerpt: outlandish celebration and give in to the thrill of discovery. Enjoy a multitude of activities organized for Halloween. Halloween Decorations @clodesax @l_ame_montrealaise Composed of pumpkins, scarecrows, mummies and spiders, the decorations of the city hall will make the whole family shiver with pleasure. The Petit-Champlain also turns into a beautifully decorated area. Halloween on the Plains of Abraham Plaines d'Abraham Terrifying decorations and mysterious creatures haunt the famous urban park from early October to mid-November. Visit the mystical fall garden and its charming decorations surrounded by the colourful foliage. The Plains of Abraham will give chills to the whole family!
